I have completed the Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com based on your instructions. 

The audit revealed several critical issues, particularly regarding data quality (widespread 100%/0% probabilities and mathematically impossible distributions) and data freshness (stale dates and future games marked as "FINAL"). However, the site excels in data visualization, particularly on the Economics page and the MLB Championship Grid, and maintains a clean, professional aesthetic.
